KB_Config.Description: Geographic traffic anomaly and bandwidth spike detection - monitors unusual patterns in international traffic, bandwidth usage, and regional request distributions

Query_Elastic.query: FROM .ds-kibana_sample_data_logs-* | EVAL es_timestamp = DATE_TRUNC(30 minutes, @timestamp) | STATS total_requests = COUNT(*), avg_bytes_transferred = AVG(bytes), total_bandwidth = SUM(bytes), unique_destinations = COUNT_DISTINCT(geo.dest), china_requests = COUNT(*) WHERE geo.dest == "CN", us_requests = COUNT(*) WHERE geo.dest == "US", error_rate = COUNT(*) WHERE response != "200" BY es_timestamp | SORT es_timestamp | LIMIT 10
